positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led the deprecation of legacy AWS Billing and Cost Management Console architecture,
and architected a modern, scalable platform that enhanced system reliability and
developer efficiency. This initiative reduced operational overhead and saved 50+
engineering hours/month, enabling faster delivery and long-term maintainability.
• Architected and executed end-to-end service consolidation strategy, unifying distributed
platforms into a centralized solution while migrating 7M+ records with zero downtime and
100% data integrity, eliminating $1M+ in annual infrastructure and operational costs.
• Designed and deployed data privacy protection service to safeguard sensitive data for
millions of customer accounts, preventing potential data leaks
• Conducted 500+ code reviews, mentored 5+ junior engineers, and facilitated 20+ sprint
planning and review sessions, accelerating release velocity by 25%

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained web services with ruby on rails using SQL server rdbms
• Created reusable user interface components and front-end libraries, involving React
• Developed solutions engineering that involved process automation and functionality
enhancement. Replaced time consuming and error-prone manual processes with automated
deployment and testing solutions to speed up production process
• Fixed various defects/bugs occurring in the production environment
• Participated in code review and quality assurance
• Improved problem solving skills of junior developers through mentoring

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
•	Designed and completed the 1st of its kind visual-based Range of Motion and Gait Analysis
prototype system for assisting physicians and physical therapists in patient body motion problem diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation through an augmented reality application using Kinect sensor, Unity 3D visualization and sensory data analytics
•	System exhibited in the American Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons (AAOS) 2016 Annual Meeting, March 1-5, Orlando, Florida
•	Developed a prototype system that enables personized virtual coaching and assessment for patient’s rehabilitation exercise routines and functional progress tracking

projects.title: Data Processing using Hadoop Map/Reduce
projects.description:
•	Configured Hadoop 2.6 version using Linux Ubuntu to create own image to deploy on Amazon Web Service
•	Designed and implemented Mappers to parse data of different music datasets and further processed using reducer to get the desired output.

projects.title: Hospital Residency
projects.description:
- Hospitals have preference for Residents and vice versa. Each Hospital has a certain number of vacancy for Residents
- Developed an application for finding the best match using Java
